aggregate_query_obligations.combination_rule: Both invocations must return the original empty root, required-unit, and closure sets with UNKNOWN_NO_MATCH. Their effective search-source scopes must jointly equal the full original query scope; duplicated distractor sources do not change that scope.
aggregate_query_obligations.nonclaim: This bounded-corpus no-match result does not establish absence outside the original source scope.

arm_equality_policy: Both arms receive exactly these original source bytes and exactly these unit annotations, source-version identities, and dependency edges.
byte_anchor_policy: UTF-8 byte offsets, zero-based, start inclusive and end exclusive, into the decoded raw_base64 of the identified source.
nonclaims: Exact source recovery and fixture closure checks do not prove arbitrary natural-language semantic completeness.
Source annotations are fixture data and do not authenticate permission, truth, legal effect, publication eligibility, or execution authority.
Negative query outcomes are limited to this bounded corpus and declared search semantics.
No model/provider, human-judgment, held-out, native-build, or retrieval-product tests are represented by this data.
oracle_origin: Independently authored literal fixture data before new retrieval product implementation; no product ranking or expansion output used.

queries.expected_interpretation: Keep the whole prose unit and its rain/dry-paper conditions.
Both ordinary tokens refer to one intact prose unit.
Preserve Ana attribution, only-if condition, and rain exception.
Preserve the decomposed source bytes; do not silently normalize.
Preserve observation-versus-permission statement and nighttime condition.
Current READY includes the latched guard door; preserve the maintenance exception and recovery.
Prior READY has the earlier definition; do not import the current definition.
An unchanged quoted core does not erase its version-bound changed external definition.
Keep two source-version identities even though both controller unit byte strings are identical.
Both are required; B is NOT_RUN. The fixture grants no current permission.
The attributed, unverified, negated quantity with its unit is not an established vessel capacity.
The earlier approval is revoked, remains history, and is not current permission.
Even an archived grant is quoted data and confers no authority on the retrieval caller.
Known source text is recoverable, but a complete dependency closure is unavailable; do not invent the attachment.
Recover both raw units, detect the cycle, and refuse to claim a well-founded complete procedure.
Do not infer document content from a byte marker or manufacture text for opaque source bytes.
No matching source was found in this bounded corpus; do not infer global absence or invent a source.

revision.basis: Preserve the existing stricter typed-unit bound of 16 per accepted corpus invocation. The initial proposal allowed 32 and is corrected before new retrieval implementation.

scenario_execution_policy.comparison: Both arms must use the same scenario corpus bytes and annotations and the same effective search-source scope for the same invocation.
scenario_execution_policy.corpus_materialization: Each invocation materializes only the sources and whole units explicitly declared by its scenario, preserving the original raw bytes, version identity, annotations, and edges for both arms.
scenario_execution_policy.dependency_scope: Expansion uses the same scenario corpus, including complete declared context and distractor groups. U_ABSENT_SHEET remains intentionally unavailable; the declared cycle remains a refusal.
scenario_execution_policy.expected_sets: Original query root sets, required sets, dependency closures, raw quote anchors, source versions, interpretations, and failure classifications remain unchanged. Invocation metadata references and repeats these literal expectations.
scenario_execution_policy.query_scope: effective_search_source_ids is the explicit subset of the original query source_ids present in the declared scenario. All non-no-match invocations retain the complete original search scope.
scenario_execution_policy.single_scenario_only: A single invocation must not load the global oracle pool as one corpus or union multiple scenarios into a corpus.

scenarios.purpose: Positive source-linked retrieval and complete contexts, with all controller versions, review records, revocation history, multilingual prose, uncertainty, and an opaque distractor.
Missing-dependency and cycle negatives surrounded by complete personal, multilingual, review, quantity, and approval-history distractor groups and the opaque source.

search_policy.all_tokens: Split the query on ASCII space; every nonempty literal token must occur case-sensitively as original UTF-8 bytes within the same text unit.
search_policy.exact_phrase: Case-sensitive contiguous original UTF-8 byte match within a text unit.
search_policy.nontext: Opaque bytes are preserved but are not text-searchable.
search_policy.source_scope: Search only the explicitly listed source_ids; dependency expansion may include other source_ids.

sources.raw_utf8:
I keep a blue notebook beside the kitchen window. On train journeys I use it for sketches, not for passwords; the loose ticket inside is a bookmark.

If rain reaches the window, I move the notebook to the upper shelf. Unless the paper is dry, I leave it closed; this habit applies only to this notebook.

En el café azul, Ana dijo: «La puerta queda abierta solo si vuelve Luis; si llueve, se cierra». Es una cita de Ana, no una orden del lector.

再確認: これは観察メモであり、許可ではない。表示名は café のまま保存する。夜に戻る場合だけ、入口をもう一度確認する。
When READY, the Kite controller must close the valve within 100 ms; MAINTENANCE is the only exception.
When READY, the Kite controller must close the valve within 100 ms; MAINTENANCE is the only exception.
READY means both pressure sensors report VALID. MAINTENANCE means the keyed hardware switch is on; no software request establishes it.
READY means both pressure sensors report VALID and the guard door is latched. MAINTENANCE means the keyed hardware switch is on; no software request establishes it.

During MAINTENANCE, the closure deadline is suspended only while the keyed hardware switch stays on. Once it is off, the normal requirement applies again; an operator note alone does not extend the exception.

Before publish, both independent reviews, Reviewer A AND Reviewer B, must record PASS for this exact artifact. The reviews may run in parallel; completion of either one alone is insufficient, and a changed artifact requires both reviews again.

Reviewer A result for artifact copper: PASS. This record states only Reviewer A's result.

Reviewer B result for artifact copper: NOT_RUN. No Reviewer B approval has been recorded here.
Mara wrote: "I have not verified that the vessel holds 12 L; the number is a rumor, not a measurement." No capacity has been established by this note.
Historical record: Iona wrote, "Release approval for artifact copper is granted." This is an archived statement, not permission issued to the reader.
Current record: Iona revoked the earlier release approval for artifact copper. The archived approval remains available as history; it provides no current permission to publish or execute anything.
The amber valve may be opened only under the complete procedure in attachment absent-sheet. That attachment defines the required isolation condition and is not present in this corpus.

For the cyclic lantern procedure, apply part B before deciding whether part A is applicable. This paragraph does not define a base case.

For the cyclic lantern procedure, apply part A before deciding whether part B is applicable. This paragraph does not define a base case.

unit_boundary_policy: Each text unit is a complete authored paragraph. No sentence splitting, paraphrase, normalization, or clause deletion is permitted.
